content.title: Chapter 86 - RETIREMENT — Sec. 86-162. - Assignability; exemption from execution.
content.summary:
The right of a person to a pension, to the return of accumulated contributions and
               any other right accrued or accruing to any member, retirant or beneficiary under the
               provisions of this chapter shall be unassignable and shall not be subject to execution,
              …

faqs.a:
The right of a person to a pension, to the return of accumulated contributions and
               any other right accrued or accruing to any member, retirant or beneficiary under the
               provisions of this chapter shall be unassignable and shall not be subject to execution,
               garnishment, attachment, the operation of bankruptcy or insolvency law or any other
               process of law whatsoever, except as is specifically provided in this chapter.
(Code 1960, § 19-22; Code 1981, § 26-86)
